report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning HTTP 200 with successful downstream calls. The only deployment record shows order 1.0.0 with no previous version, while metrics show 2.0.0 present but serving zero requests. No error statuses or failure evidence appear. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry for checkout or order (non-2xx status, error spans, exception logs) to confirm checkout errors exist
Logs for order service (excluded evidence ev-56f9150e5abcd594-r0-logs-order) to inspect error details
Deployment records covering version 2.0.0 of order, since metrics show 2.0.0 traffic but deploy record only shows 1.0.0
Baseline latency/error metrics before the incident window to assess whether p95 230ms on /v1/orders is anomalous
